<!-- plain-summary -->
When something fails inside wyrd, the error that crosses the trait seam is an untyped string (`BoxError`) — callers, retry logic, and operators cannot tell a transient fault ("try again") from a terminal one ("data is gone / config is wrong"). This introduces the typed transient/terminal error enum extending `IntegrityFault` that proposal 0010 names, so failure class survives the trait and gRPC seams.

**Parent:** #366 (floor item 6). Spec: proposal 0010 (`docs/design/proposals/draft/0010-observability-floor-for-first-deployment.md`), §"Scope boundary" item 6.

## Sequencing (ratified — do not re-litigate)

The 0010 sequencing question against #255 (M4.4, the TiKV `MetadataStore` behind the same `crates/traits` seam) was **determined at the #366 keystone sign-off (2026-07-04, recorded in the PDCA bundle §10 / iteration-7 ratification): #255 merged onto the M4 branch first, so the typed-error enum lands AFTER M4 and adapts the TiKV backend** to produce the new variants. 0010's graduation criteria require this decision recorded in 0010/an ADR — do that as part of this issue if Act has not already.

## Scope (from 0010)

- Typed transient/terminal error enum extending `IntegrityFault` at `crates/traits`.
- The TiKV `MetadataStore` (and other backends) produce the new variants; the DST property 0010 names — typed errors surviving the gRPC seam — attaches here.
- Related but narrower prior art: #515 gave the tikv undetermined-commit class a typed error; this issue is the seam-wide enum.

milestone.description: Step 2. Swap embedded redb for distributed TiKV behind the unchanged MetadataStore trait; multi-key atomic directory ops hold under the distributed store. Completes the single-zone data plane — a soft stopping point, not the release: the ★ Step-2 release point is M8 (proposal 0013 implementation arc, supersedes 0002). Plan: proposal 0015 (supersedes 0007; acceptance PR #417); tracker #201; first-deployment gate #367.

title: Typed transient/terminal errors extending IntegrityFault (observability floor item 6; after M4 per ratified sequencing)
